personajes.en: Mestiza woman with deep tan, black braided hair under an olive aguayo headscarf. Worn mauve blouse, dark wool skirt, rubber boots. Holds a burlap sack of small seed potatoes, red woven sash at waist.

Afro-Colombian woman with short curly hair, bright yellow blouse and gray apron over jeans, white sneakers. Stands with hands on a market scale, colorful plastic shopping bags and small cash wallet in one hand.

Mestizo man with thick mustache, weathered face, white baseball cap. Checked flannel shirt, brown trousers, leather boots. Holds a wooden gearshift knob, red poncho folded over one shoulder against highland cold.

NASA authority with broad weathered features, straight black hair, wearing the Guambia dress: navy-blue flowing skirt-like mantle, white shirt, black felt hat with small colored ribbons, walking stick in hand, red beaded necklace.

Misak woman with strong features, black braided hair, wearing the misak dress: deep blue wrapped skirt-mantle, white blouse, colorful beaded collar and bracelets, black felt hat, carrying a teacher's notebook and chalk box.

Mestizo man with lean build, short black hair, dusty white T-shirt under an unbuttoned orange safety vest, dark work jeans, yellow hard hat pushed back, holding a trowel and measuring tape, worn sneakers.

Young woman with light brown skin, long dark hair in a ponytail, denim jacket over a white T-shirt, black leggings, running shoes, backpack on one shoulder, smartphone in hand, small earthenware bracelet.
Elderly mestizo man with gray mustache, deep wrinkles, dark ruana wool poncho over white shirt, black trousers, rubber boots, alpargata cord hat in hand, wooden cane, an old analog wristwatch.
